title: Union Project Ceramics Classes with Firing Methods
source_quote: Firing workshops also explore different firing methods like gas reduction, soda, and Raku.
evidence_sentence: The classes page states that firing workshops explore gas reduction, soda, and raku firing methods.
evidence_quote: Firing workshops also explore different firing methods like gas reduction, soda, and Raku.
summary: Union Project offers firing workshops that explore raku, soda, and gas reduction firing methods. Classes run in four sessions per year (Winter, Spring, Summer, Fall). Registration opens seasonally and classes fill on a first-come, first-served basis.
how_to_join: Sign up through the class registration system; classes fill first-come, first-served
